data.title: Electricity price increase from 1 November 2026
data.summary: Stadtwerke Musterstadt GmbH announces higher electricity prices for the MusterStrom Flex tariff from 1 November 2026. Yearly costs rise from €577.08 to €647.28 and the monthly advance payment from €48.00 to €54.00 from 15 November 2026.
data.explanation: Your electricity supplier is raising its prices: the usage price goes from 32.90 to 36.40 ct/kWh and the base fee from €11.90 to €13.90 per month. Your monthly advance payment (Abschlag) rises to €54.00 from 15 November 2026. You have a special right to cancel (Sonderkündigungsrecht) without a notice period, effective when the change takes effect. The cancellation must reach the supplier in text form before the change takes effect. The app shows until when. You can stay, or compare tariffs and switch. Check your bank standing order or direct debit for the new amount.
